source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt:
Create a cinematic, photorealistic 3D-rendered scene of a cozy futuristic pharmacology research lab at night, in a wide 16:9 composition. A reflective metal worktable fills the foreground. Floating above its center is a luminous turquoise glass DNA double helix, with small amber-gold molecular nodes and a geometric chemical structure branching off its lower right side.

On the left wall, a large transparent dark digital display outlined in cyan reads “EvidenceGrade AI” in bold white lettering. Under “5-tier grade,” show five horizontal color-coded bars labeled “A,” “B,” “C,” “D,” and “F,” in green, teal, yellow, orange, and red. Beside them is an upward-trending cyan line chart titled “Citation Confidence 2019-2026,” with a vertical scale from 0 to 60.

In the foreground, an open spiral notebook rests on a brown leather folio, with a black and gold pen across its pages. The handwritten notes include “CYP3A4” and “risk”; the remaining writing is indistinct. At right sits a white cracked-glaze coffee cup with a teal takeaway lid on a saucer.

Behind the helix, wall shelves hold amber medicine bottles labeled “Aspirin,” “Warfarin,” and “Ibuprofen,” a few laboratory vials, and binders; a brass microscope and a potted monstera plant sit below. Overhead, articulated brass lamps and a green-shaded lamp cast warm pools of light.

On the right, an enormous arched window looks out onto a rainy neon-lit city street, with pink and cyan signs bearing mostly unreadable Chinese characters reflected in the wet pavement. A black cat sits in silhouette on the windowsill, and a folded red umbrella leans below it. Moody blue-gray shadows, soft rain haze, warm amber highlights, cyan holographic glow, detailed glass and metal reflections, atmospheric depth, polished sci-fi aesthetic.
